headline: Barclays Maintains Overweight on Hilton Worldwide Holdings, Raises Price Target to $384
summary: Barclays  analyst Brandt Montour   maintains Hilton Worldwide Holdings (NYSE:HLT) with a Overweight and raises the price target from $368 to $384.

headline: Is The Market Underpricing Airbnb Stock?
summary: Airbnb (ABNB) stock trades at 38.3 times its earnings over the four quarters to fiscal Q2 2026. This valuation sits above the 28.3 average recorded at quarter-ends over the last twelve fiscal quarters, excluding readings above 100. Investors paying this premium may be betting that the company will continue to add guests and keep more of each booking as profit.
